name: reopen
about: From an open console: quit, reopen the installed launcher, open the saved network, unlock the wallet setup made, continue without an account, and land on the console again. The launcher applies a staged release at this boot. A saved network with NO wallet goes from Open network straight to Protect your wallet (setup always makes one, so Welcome back shows here). Ends with the console open.

steps.say: L5 the reopened app lists the saved network

steps.expect: the Welcome back step shows with a Wallet password field and an Unlock button

steps.say: put the wallet password into the Wallet password field

steps.expect: the app moves on from the Welcome back step: the account step (Your account) or the workspace shows; no error sentence

steps.say: L5 after unlock the account step or the workspace shows

steps.expect: the workspace console opens with its rail of tabs, or is opening

steps.say: L5 the reopened app lands on the workspace after unlock
